data.name: Anithra
data.gender_notes: Anithra is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Anithra is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Anitha', which means 'Goddess of peace and prosperity'. She is known to bring harmony, happiness, and abundance into people's lives. The name Anithra carries the meaning “Goddess of peace and prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Anithra usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of peace and prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Anithra belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of peace and prosperity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Anithra total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

historical_references.reference: Anithra was an early Jaina Tirthankara, whose teachings were largely focused on self-discipline and non-violence.

historical_references.reference: Anithra is also mentioned in the Hindu epic Mahabharata as the name of a queen of the Naga king, Takshaka, who was known for her great beauty and wisdom.
